title: Auto Derive Dark Pdf
description: Stop hand-maintaining six *-dark.tex wrapper files and six duplicate TEMPLATES entries in print/script.ts. Derive each dark PDF automatically at build time from its canonical light .tex file, and let logo/image assets optionally supply a -dark variant by convention.
summary:
Dark PDFs are now derived automatically at build time instead of being hand-maintained as separate template files.

- Collapsed `TEMPLATES` in `print/script.ts` to 6 canonical families; `compileTemplate` writes a sibling `*-dark.tex` (theme=light → theme=dark) and compiles both light and dark PDFs.
- Watch mode ignores regenerated `*-dark.tex` artifacts; `resolveTemplates` still accepts legacy `*-dark` filter ids.
- Deleted 6 hand-written `*-dark.tex` wrappers; added `print/.gitignore` for regenerated artifacts.
- `semio-logo.sty` resolves optional `-dark` image variants by convention when theme is dark.
- Fixed missing `\dim_new:N` declarations in `semio-window.sty` uncovered during verification.

Verified: `bun ./script.ts test` builds all 12 PDFs.
